$comment: Machine contract for findings.json. validate-findings.cjs is the authoritative checker for these shapes plus the status-conditional rules that schemas cannot express (confirmed gates, rejected refutation, uncertain settle-record). Keep this file and the validator in sync.

id.description: <blockId>-<nn> for block findings; <parentId>-v<n> for runtime variants. Never renumbered between passes.

block.description: The ledger block this finding came from. Must exist in coverage-ledger.json.

fingerprint.description: Stable source-derived root-cause identifier. Survives every status change. Two live findings sharing a fingerprint is a merge failure.

severity.description: Impact-based, assuming stated preconditions. Independent of confidence; unverified severity is conditional until confirmed.

confidence.description: low-confidence findings must not be reported as confirmed.

quote.description: short, redacted; never credentials, tokens, or full payloads

needs_runtime.description: true when only execution can settle the question; requires runtime_question.

runtime_question.description: The exact executable question, phrased so a runtime agent can answer it.

blocked_on.description: For uncertain: the exact missing fact (deployment config, provider behavior, platform fact not in the repo) and what would settle it. Not a confidence note.

duplicate_of.description: For status=duplicate: the surviving finding id. Required and must resolve.

x-status-conditional-rules.$comment: Enforced by validate-findings.cjs, listed here as the contract:
confirmed: if needs_runtime is true: verification.runtime in confirmed/not_required/out_of_scope (an explicit decision, not silence)
rejected: at least one evidence entry or a notes entry refuting the claim
uncertain: blocked_on, runtime_question, or notes states what would settle it
duplicate: duplicate_of resolves to a live finding id, not itself
collection: ids unique across the whole collection
at most one non-duplicate finding per fingerprint
